channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect, as experts say they may not hold up
item.description: President Donald Trump has renewed a flurry of tariffs, including slapping 25% duties on Brazilian imports and vowing 50% tariffs on goods from Canada.

item.title: Nvidia locks down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of $500 billion AI deal
item.description: Nvidia is aggressively securing supply of high-bandwidth memory, an essential component for its GPUs and systems.

item.title: Saudi military strikes Houthi targets in Yemen after the Iran-backed militia attacked Red Sea shipping
item.description: Saudi Arabia intercepted two ballistic missiles from Yemen, Greek security sources told Reuters, as fighting in a second front in the Iran war escalates.

item.title: Trump mixes jokes with barbs at press freedom dinner
item.description: The black-tie gathering was called off on April 25 after a man tried to force his way through a security checkpoint and fired a shotgun.

item.title: Megacap earnings and Fed meeting could test a market on edge next week. Here’s what’s ahead
item.description: There's no shortage of hurdles the stock market will have to jump in the week ahead.

item.title: SpaceX launches massive Starship rocket in first test flight since IPO
item.description: Elon Musk's rocket maker is conducting the first test fight for its massive Starship rocket since the company's IPO last month.

item.title: S&P 500 closes little changed Friday as Iran fears and chip sell-off weigh down market: Live updates
item.description: The three major averages are heading for weekly losses, led by the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite.

item.title: JPMorgan report finds dramatic jump in AI-themed ETFs — despite rough quarter
item.description: Wall Street is banking heavily on exchange-traded funds that give investors artificial intelligence exposure, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.

item.title: CDC says massive cyclospora outbreak is now in nine states
item.description: The four newly linked states — Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma and Pennsylvania — join Indiana, Kentucky, Ohio, West Virginia and hard-hit Michigan.

item.title: Finland’s radical answer to renewable energy’s biggest headache: The world’s largest sand battery
item.description: A small Finnish town has turned to the world's largest commercial sand battery to tackle a major hurdle in the energy transition: intermittency.

item.title: Boom in tech wealth is fueling record prices for dinosaur bones, art and watches, auction houses say
item.description: The major auction houses racked up nearly $10 billion in sales in the first half, marking one of the strongest-ever starts to the year.

item.title: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
item.description: Many types of consumer loans such as mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.

item.title: LeBron James joining Philadelphia 76ers for record-extending 24th NBA season
item.description: LeBron James announced he will join the Philadelphia 76ers for his record-extending 24th NBA season after eight seasons with the Los Angeles Lakers.

item.title: Why the Federal Reserve should hike rates next week
item.description: The Fed cannot know the exact path of inflation, but the potential cost of an energy-driven surge in prices outweighs the cost of a modest preemptive hike.

item.title: Paramount agrees to delay WBD acquisition to as late as June 2027 amid legal challenge
item.description: Paramount previously said it intended to complete its WBD acquisition by the end of September, but said Friday the agreement is a "significant win."

item.title: Uber and Waymo to end exclusivity arrangement in Atlanta and Austin
item.description: In Atlanta and Austin, Texas, Waymo driverless rides will be available on platforms other than Uber starting in 2028.

item.title: Trump defends DOJ subpoenas of NY Times reporters; Google also was targeted
item.description: The DOJ is investigating the leak to The New York Times of security concerns about President Donald Trump's new Air Force One plane, donated by Qatar.

item.title: Musk's bad week: Tesla suffers worst slump since 2022, SpaceX drops ahead of Starship test flight
item.description: Tesla shares plunged almost 18% this week after the company missed on earnings and turned cash flow negative.

item.title: Trump considers ‘massive attack’ on Iran; Pakistan reportedly seeks to restart stalled peace talks
item.description: The president told Axios he was considering an operation "bigger than ever before" before Reuters reported Pakistan is seeking to restart peace talks.

item.title: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets
item.description: Google, Amazon and Meta are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward on companies they lend to.

item.title: 1 hyperscaler megacap down, 3 to go. Alphabet raises the stakes on AI spending
item.description: "Capex trends are going to be the number one focus," Club portfolio director Jeff Marks said Friday ahead of next week's Big Tech earnings.

item.title: Tariffs and gas prices are intensifying the affordability crunch. These 3 products can help
item.description: Americans are facing higher prices as the Iran war continues and new tariffs go into effect.

item.title: Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea
item.description: More than 60 commercial ships have been attacked in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman since March 1.

item.title: Oil falls on report Pakistan is pushing for new U.S.-Iran talks with China's backing
item.description: Oil prices dropped by around 3% on Friday, but remained on track for a weekly jump of 10% as the U.S.-Iran war continued to escalate.

item.title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
item.description: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.

item.title: Trader who successfully shorted Tesla into earnings now sets sights on this high flyer
item.description: The bearish Tesla set-up we flagged ahead of Wednesday's report has delivered most of what it can.

item.title: Anthropic's new AI model rivals Fable 5 and is cheaper as businesses fret about costs
item.description: Anthropic said Claude Opus 5 is its best performing and its most cost-effective offering.

item.title: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta warn against 'premature restrictions' of open-weight models
item.description: Chinese open-weight models are gaining steam against leading offerings from American companies. OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign the letter.

item.title: As Honda CR-V leads U.S. sales, automaker teases new American-built pickup truck
item.description: The future of the Ridgeline midsize pickup truck had been in flux, and the automaker said there will be a temporary production stoppage for the truck.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic may not return to normal for 12 months or more, according to prediction markets
item.description: Kalshi traders give less than 50% odds that the key maritime passageway will fully reopen by July 2027.
